When I was 3 years old, I once rode in a police car.
It was an afternoon of a certain winter day.
I was going to go to my friend Ken's house to play.
enMap.Mẹ tôi có vẻ bận bởi vì chăm sóc em trai: My mother seemed busy taking care of my younger brother, so I said, "I'm going to Ken's house" and went out alone.
I was wearing a pair of old boots.
enMap.Anh họ của tôi đã lớn nên không thể mang: My cousin had grown and they no longer fit him, so he gave them to me.
enMap.Tôi nhớ rất rõ việc tôi vừa mới nhận nó: I remember very clearly being delighted that I had just received them.
enMap.Nhà Ken ở tầng năm tòa nhà bên cạnh, tòa: Ken's house was on the fifth floor of the building next door, a building with four entrances.
enMap.Tôi đã đến chơi nhiều lần nhưng không bi: I had been to play there many times but didn't know exactly which one it was.
enMap.Tôi nghĩ \"Chắc là cửa đi vào thứ 2 từ p: I thought, "It's probably the second entrance from the right," and tried to climb up to the fifth floor.
enMap.Tôi đã gõ cửa, người phụ nữ mở cửa là ng: I knocked on the door, and the woman who opened it was someone I didn't know at all.
enMap.Tôi đã nói: \"Con chơi với Ken\", nhưng: I said, "I'm here to play with Ken," but that woman didn't know Ken.
They had just moved in here.
enMap.Họ hỏi tên nên tôi đã trả lời là: \"Mino: They asked my name, so I answered, "Minoru."
enMap.Hỏi nhà ở đâu, tên bố tôi là gì nhưng tô: They asked where my house was and what my father's name was, but I couldn't answer.
enMap.Người phụ nữ kiểm tra quần áo và đôi ủng: The woman checked my clothes and boots, and found a name, my cousin's, written inside the boots.
enMap.Nhưng mà, tên đó khác với tên tôi đã nói: But that name was different from the name I had said, and since there was no address, the woman took me to a nearby police box.
The police officer asked my home and my name.
enMap.Tôi đã trả lời tên, nhưng cảnh sát cũng: I answered my name, but the officer also looked at the name in my boots and didn't believe what I said.
enMap.Tôi đã được đưa đến sở cảnh sát bằng xe: I was taken to the police station by police car.
enMap.Viên cảnh sát khác cũng đã hỏi giống như: Another officer asked the same questions, but I didn't answer anything more.
At about 5 o'clock my parents finally came.
enMap.Là lúc tôi vừa xem Tivi vừa ăn bánh mì m: It was while I was watching TV and eating the bread the police had given me.
I looked at my parents' faces and cried very loudly.
enMap.Mẹ tôi đã đến nhà Ken để đón tôi nhưng k: My mother had gone to Ken's house to pick me up but I wasn't there, so she panicked.
My parents were scolded by the police.
enMap.Từ đó tôi tự hào rằng mình đã từng ngồi: Since then I have been proud of having once sat in a police car for a while.
